title: The Deepest Thought Layer

features.name: pressure-stratification
features.desc-on-touch: Each layer of bedrock is thinking the same thought, but at different speeds. The deepest layer thinks the slowest. By the time its thought reaches the surface, new layers have already contradicted it.

features.name: root-logic-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: Roots push down into thought, and thought pushes back. Neither one retreats. They are learning argument.

features.name: sediment-archive
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of memory compressed into mineral. The oldest thought is the smallest, crushed under the weight of all the thinking that came after. But it is still thinking.

features.name: depth-marker
features.desc-on-touch: A stone carved with depths, each one deeper than it was yesterday. The stone is slowly descending, thinking as it falls.

features.name: thought-pool-below-thought
features.desc-on-touch: An underground water source where the thought goes when it stops moving. The water tastes like the oldest thinking. It has no words.

inscription: the bedrock thinks all thoughts at once; the surface only hears the ones that have aged enough to become true

file.name: Thought_Iterations_Bedrock_Pressure_Log.txt
